notes.rule: Project and repo slugs are lowercase; deriveSlug sanitizes to [a-z0-9._-], so digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens all survive (e.g. v1.2.3).
Slugs are 60 characters or fewer (SLUG_MAX), including the hyphens but excluding the .md suffix.
notes.example: plans/projects/personal-agent-skills.md is at the upper bound

notes.rule: Stems _index and _archive are reserved for daemon-maintained files and not in use as project slugs.
notes.example: plans/projects/_index.md is a directory listing, not a project file
